title: Janus v2.2.4 — Fix Mobile App Version Check & Real-Time Phone Media Browser
notes: Fix Mobile Version Check: Resolved persistent update popup on phone by dynamically binding BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME
Fix Media Loading: Added Android 14 visual user selected permission support and bypassed scoped storage restrictions on downloads
Fix Photo Query: Handled null bucket name logic in SQLite query so camera roll pictures are returned accurately
Real-Time Connection Sync: Desktop UI now prunes disconnected clients and accurately shows real-time phone connection status
Enhanced Media Preview: Boosted preview thumbnails from 8 to 24 items with crisp 128x128 resolution
